### Punk Night: Some Remain, Nichts & Zrangorn

![Punk Night](news/punk-night.jpeg)

Late-night punk concert at Ballina Arts Centre presented by Ballina Punx and the NCF. Brace yourself for the energetic performances of SOME REMAIN, NICHTS, and ZRANGORN and join us for a standing concert with a full bar ready for your enjoyment.

### About the Bands

#### SOME REMAIN (Sligo)
Some Remain are a four piece alternative punk band hailing from Sligo. Showcasing a vigorous blend of jagged 70s post punk, sharp noise and catchy hooks, Some Remain bring a powerful live energy to their live performances. With kinetic drumming, punchy bass lines and abrasive yet catchy guitar lines, fronted with a combination of aggressive and melodic vocals, their sound is infectious and gets the crowd spilling their drinks and grooving their arses off. Earlier this year they released a 7″ single on Galway's Blowtorch records, the same label that recently released Nerves EP.

#### NICHTS (Ballina)
Ballina's newest band! Punk rock 5 piece with a stoner-metal edge. Featuring ex members of The Jollars, Only Fumes and Corpses, Shithatt and GSB.

#### ZRANGORN (Ballina)
Zrangorn is the, until now, recording project of Conor Hickey (and friends). Since 2020 a number of digital singles have been released, All The Sound, Black Berlin and Blood Onion. The recordings are often multi-layered and feature unconventional instruments. This first live performance will however feature just 2 musicians, Conor and guitar and vocals and long-time collaborator Padraig MacNally.
